name: PdxTabs
description:
Tabs the user switches between, each showing its own panel, with keyboard navigation, lazy
mounting and closable tabs.

members.name: bordered
members.description: Add border around entire tabs + panels

members.name: mount
members.description: Mount strategy: eager (all mounted), lazy (mount on first activate), unmount (destroy on deactivate)

members.name: activation
members.description: Activation: automatic (activate on focus) or manual (Enter/Space to activate)

members.name: variant
members.description: line (the default), card (a bordered container) or pills (rounded buttons).

members.name: select
members.description: Activate a tab by its `data-tab` value, not by its position.

events.name: pdx-close
events.description: A tab's close button removed it and its panel; the value is the removed tab's. Does not bubble.

events.name: value-change
events.description: Fired when the component writes `value`. Does not bubble.

attributes.name: bordered

slots.description: The content placed inside the element.

cssParts.name: list
cssParts.description: The strip of tabs, the `role="tablist"` element the author wrote (`.pdx-tabs`).

cssParts.name: indicator
cssParts.description: The bar under the active tab, which slides to it (not with `variant="pills"`).

cssStates.name: loading
cssStates.description: `loading` is set: the active panel is `aria-busy`.

cssStates.name: bordered
cssStates.description: `bordered` is set: a border around the strip and the panels.

cssStates.name: overflow
cssStates.description: The tabs do not fit in one row: the strip keeps one row and scrolls.
